action: Students and staff: as the university states, watch its official channels for the reactivation of each digital service; documents can be obtained in person at the student services counters.
date_note: Both pages (23 Nov) relay a university statement that says only that the attack came 'during the past week'; no earlier day is given, so the publication day is used.
exec: A North Macedonian university says a cyberattack on its digital infrastructure made part of its digital services unavailable, while teaching continues.
geo_basis: city named in the skopjeinfo.mk headline (Štip); university's city
plain: Goce Delchev University in Štip says it was hit by a cyberattack and some digital services are temporarily unavailable. The university says its backups are intact and that teaching continues.

summary: Goce Delchev University says it was the target of a cyberattack on its digital infrastructure during the past week, according to a university statement relayed by plusinfo.mk and skopjeinfo.mk. The university says it isolated the affected systems and reported the incident to the national incident response centre MKD-CIRT. It says its backups are valid and preserved, that part of its digital services are temporarily unavailable and that teaching continues.
title: Goce Delchev University in Štip says cyberattack made part of its digital services unavailable

validation.note: plusinfo.mk and skopjeinfo.mk both relay one university statement, so it is a single statement; the university's own page was not read. The backups and data-safety claims are the university's alone.
